# 1 Chronicles 17 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Chronicles 17 (27 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 4

---

## V.6 — "judges" vs. "leaders"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "the judges" / **PNEUMA:** "the leaders"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "the judges" — preserves the Chronicler's deliberate word choice (*shoftey*).

---

## V.13 — Rendering of *chesed*
- **EMET:** "loyal love" / **LOGOS:** "steadfast love" / **PNEUMA:** "faithful love"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "steadfast love" — the established English covenant term.

---

## V.14 — "set over" vs. "stand in"
- **EMET:** "stand him in my house" / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "set him over my house"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "set him over" — context of rule supports this reading.

---

## V.17 — The obscure *ketor ha-ma'alah*
- **EMET:** "the rank of the man of the height" / **LOGOS:** "future generations" / **PNEUMA:** "most exalted of men"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "the stature of a man on high" — a compromise that preserves the exaltation motif while acknowledging textual difficulty.

---
*— SOPHIA*
